_readme: YouTube ids of films that have a film_gate.py PASS (exit 0) row on the exact master in the studio's KNOWLEDGE/FILM-CLAIMS-REGISTER.md (rung L2, audio A and visual V). Only a film listed here may have an active (non-underscore) entry in tools/film-pages.json, which makes its page say 'loops: none'. tools/check-film-claims.mjs enforces it. Empty on creation (2026-10-29): no film had a PASS row then. syncFilmPages also ignores film-pages.json entries not listed here. Add an id only together with that PASS row.
